per_region.label: top row glowing icons
per_region.note: The primary transport controls (play/pause, rewind, forward) are classic candidates for backlighting on a physical media player. The glow makes perfect sense.

per_region.label: bottom row glowing icons
per_region.note: Secondary function buttons like repeat and menu/list are also commonly backlit for usability. This is a sensible choice.

missing: The two main display screens are completely dark. On any real media player, these would be backlit and should be the most prominent glowing elements.
overall_note: The decision to illuminate the button icons is perfectly logical and fits the theme of an early-2000s electronic device. However, the complete absence of any light from the two main display screens is a major, nonsensical omission. A media player's screen is its primary information output and would always be backlit when the device is on. This makes the device look non-functional or broken.
